newsitem.title: CHINA: China to purchase $30 mln equipment from Rotec.
newsitem.headline: China to purchase $30 mln equipment from Rotec.

text.p: China has decided to purchase $30.4 million worth of concrete moving equipment from Rotec Industries of the U.S. for construction work on the huge Three Gorges dam project, the Xinhua news agency said on Saturday.

The Three Gorges Project Development Corporation, which is in charge of the project, asked China Resources Corporation to purchase the equipment from Rotec Industries. China has already purchased four tower belts from the company.

The equipment was bought through competitive bidding for the second stage of the project that runs from the end of 1997 to 2003. A total of 13 companies, including France's Potain, C.S. Johnson of the U.S. and Japan's Mitsubishi, were involved in the bidding that started in August 1995, Xinhua said.
The Three Gorges project will dam the Yangtze River to create a huge hydroelectric power station.
